Post Date: 2021-03-05T10:27:05Z

Title: How to downgrade from version 20.12.7.3 to 20.4.4.18 with Atomic database created
Description: I created some Atomic databases in 20.12.7.3, when I need to downgrade the server to 20.4.4.18 there's always errors like below: 
`{} <Error> Application: DB::Exception: Syntax error (in file /var/lib/clickhouse/metadata/default.sql): failed at position 19 (line 1, col 19): UUID '6ef8d876-bd4e-44bc-bc44-2f2e950e3f20'
ENGINE = Atomic
. Expected one of: storage definition, ENGINE, ON
`
How can I smoothly do the downgrade? 
I tried to set allow_experimental_database_atomic=1 in users.xml, but it doesn't work.

CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is about downgrading ClickHouse server from version 20.12.7.3 to 20.4.4.18 when Atomic databases have been created. The error occurs because Atomic database engine was introduced in a newer version and isn't supported in the older version the user wants to downgrade to. This is a compatibility issue that can be analyzed without building or running the code. The solution would involve either:

1. Converting the Atomic databases to a compatible format before downgrading
2. Exporting data and reimporting it in the older version with compatible database engines
3. Explaining that downgrading to a version that doesn't support a feature used in the current databases isn't directly possible

This is a conceptual compatibility issue that can be verified through documentation and knowledge of ClickHouse version features rather than requiring a build environment to test the solution.
